## How to debug functions in R

Following example is borrowed from Hadley Wickham advanced R: <https://adv-r.hadley.nz/debugging.html>

### Locating errors

Here’s a example: you can see that f() calls g() calls h() calls i(), which checks if its argument is numeric:

```{r}
f <- function(a) g(a)
g <- function(b) h(b)
h <- function(c) i(c)
i <- function(d) {
  if (!is.numeric(d)) {
    stop("`d` must be numeric", call. = FALSE)
  }
  d + 10
}

# debug(f)

f("Hello")

# undebug(f)
```

Here’s another example:

```{r}
toDebug <- function() {
    a = 1
    b = 2
    browser()
    for(i in 1:100) {
        a = a * b
    }
    return(a)
}

toDebug()
```
